hood.snap_note: Most stores that take a Bridge card are corner stores and gas stations. Each side of a street has its own bus stop. A stop close by does not mean the bus comes often.

hood.roads_note: The City rates main streets, not side streets, from 1 to 10. Poor means 1 to 4. Freeways are left out. The share is by length of street.

od.title: Someone is overdosing
od.s1: Call 911. Say someone is not breathing.
od.s2: Try to wake them. Shout their name. Rub the middle of their chest hard.
od.s3: If you have Narcan, spray it into one nostril.
od.s4: If they are not breathing, give one breath every 5 seconds if you know how.
od.s5: No change after 2 to 3 minutes? Give a second dose in the other nostril.
od.s6: Lay them on their side. Stay with them until help comes.
od.review_note: These steps follow national public health guidance.

about.title: About this app
about.p1: This app lists free help from the City of Detroit and community groups. Info can change. If it's an emergency, call 911.
about.p2: We don't collect your name, number, or location. There are no accounts. What you tap stays on this phone.
about.p3: Not an official City of Detroit app.
about.p4: Each listing says where it came from and when someone last checked it. If nobody has checked it, we say so.
about.sig_ok: This list is signed, and the signature checked out.
about.sig_dev: Test build: this list is signed with a test key.
about.open: The code and the list are open for anyone to check or reuse.
privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.sub: What this app keeps, and what it sends
privacy.lede: This app never asks who you are. Here is everything it keeps and everything it sends.
privacy.phone_1: The list of places, so the app works without internet.
privacy.phone_2: Places you save. You can clear them any time.
privacy.phone_4: A random key made on this phone. It is never sent.
privacy.phone_5: Reports waiting for a signal. They go out when you are back online.
privacy.where: If you tap "Use my location" or type a ZIP code, it is used on this phone to sort places by distance. It is never saved or sent.
privacy.sent_h: Sent only when you tap Send
privacy.sent_1: When you report a place (for example, "closed") or add a place: which place, what kind of report, your note if you wrote one, and the time. Phone numbers and emails in notes are removed before anything is kept.
privacy.sent_2: A code for that place and that day, made from your random key, so one phone counts once. It changes every day and for every place, so no one can link your reports to each other or to you.
privacy.never: No name, phone number, email, account, ads, or tracking. We never keep your internet address.
privacy.reset: Make a new random key. Reports you send after this can't be matched to ones you sent before, even on the same day.
privacy.reset_done: Done. This phone has a new key.
report.kind.out_of_stock: Out of supplies or food today

report.things_only: Tell us about things that need fixing, not about people. If someone is hurt or in danger, call 911.
report.sent: Thanks. We got it. No name or number was sent.
report.queued: Thanks. We'll send this when you're back online.
report.sent_place: Thanks. We can't promise when it gets fixed. If someone is hurt or in danger, call 911.
